title: Discovery of an EP300 Inhibitor using Structure-based Virtual Screening and Bioactivity Evaluation.
authors: Pan, Dabo; Huang, Yaxuan; Jiang, Dewen; Zhang, Yonghao; Wu, Mingkai; Han, Minzhen; Jin, Xiaojie
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和MD模拟发现EP300小分子抑制剂，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: EP300 (E1A binding protein p300) played a significant role in serial diseases such as cancer, neurodegenerative disease. Therefore, it became a significant target. METHODS: Targeting EP300 discovery of a novel drug to alleviate these diseases. In this paper, 17 candidate compounds were obtained using a structure-based virtual screening approach, 4449-0460, with an IC(50) of 5.89 +/- 2.08 uM, which was identified by the EP300 bioactivity test. 4449-0460 consisted of three rings. The middle benzene ring connected the 5-ethylideneimidazolidine-2,4-dione group and the 3-F-Phenylmethoxy group. RESULTS: Furthermore, the interaction mechanism between 4449-0460 and EP300 was explored by combining molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and binding free energy calculation methods. CONCLUSION: The binding free energy of EP300 with 4449-0460 was -10.93 kcal/mol, and mainly came from the nonpolar energy term (DeltaG(nonpolar)). Pro1074, Phe1075, Val1079, Leu1084, and Val1138 were the key residues in EP300/4449-0460 binding with more -1 kcal/mol energy contribution. 4449-0460 was a promising inhibitor targeting EP300, which had implications for the development of drugs for EP300-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：EP300（E1A结合蛋白p300）在多种疾病中发挥重要作用，如癌症、神经退行性疾病。因此，它成为一个重要靶点。方法：针对EP300发现新型药物以缓解这些疾病。本文通过基于结构的虚拟筛选方法获得17个候选化合物，其中4449-0460经EP300生物活性测试鉴定，其IC(50)为5.89 ± 2.08 μM。4449-0460由三个环组成，中间苯环连接5-亚乙基咪唑烷-2,4-二酮基团和3-氟苯甲氧基团。结果：此外，通过结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和结合自由能计算方法，探讨了4449-0460与EP300之间的相互作用机制。结论：EP300与4449-0460的结合自由能为-10.93 kcal/mol，主要来自非极性能量项（DeltaG(nonpolar)）。Pro1074、Phe1075、Val1079、Leu1084和Val1138是EP300/4449-0460结合中的关键残基，其能量贡献超过-1 kcal/mol。4449-0460是一种有前景的靶向EP300抑制剂，对EP300相关疾病的药物开发具有重要意义。
